Accounts formerly known as being LPMA are Margin Accounts with 1:1 leverage, and the provisions within the LPMA Agreement have been repositioned into the Customer Account Agreement and Margin Risk Disclosures available at legal.drivewealth.com. Please contact your DriveWealth Relationship Manager with any questions. `}
